entries.title: How to use NPSE
entries.purpose: Understand the product, database and daily research workflow.
entries.how: Start with the five-minute loop; then read the storage comparison and try a CSV export.
entries.note: Learning pages load independently of the research API.

entries.title: Decision Board
entries.purpose: See qualified candidates, preliminary priorities and reasons to wait.
entries.how: Check the observation date first, then open a company and its evidence gaps.
entries.note: 0/3 is valid when evidence gates are not met.

entries.title: Candidates
entries.purpose: Browse company research states.
entries.how: Compare WHY, WHY WAIT, confidence and missing evidence; a preliminary priority is not an approved buy.
entries.note: Uses the current research API result.

entries.title: Six sector models
entries.purpose: Compare businesses within the right financial model.
entries.how: Choose banks, hydropower, manufacturing, microfinance, life or non-life insurance.
entries.note: Evidence completeness differs by company and sector.

entries.title: Example company: EBL
entries.purpose: Learn to inspect one complete company research page.
entries.how: Read the rule trace, source observations, valuation scenarios, thesis and exit conditions.
entries.note: Example navigation; not a recommendation to buy EBL.

entries.title: Methodology
entries.purpose: See source IDs, formula IDs, sector rules and implementation assumptions.
entries.how: Match a company rule ID to its source and formula; keep documented principles separate from engine choices.
entries.note: 37 registered sources do not mean 37 connected feeds.

entries.title: Sources and evidence health
entries.purpose: Inspect source roles, freshness and discrepancies.
entries.how: Compare observed date with retrieval date, then inspect original evidence.
entries.note: No detected conflict does not prove that independent sources agree.

entries.title: Market diagnostics
entries.purpose: Inspect secondary index, turnover and market observations.
entries.how: Treat older or unverified observations as diagnostics; follow the link to price/volume research.
entries.note: This is the older tracker, separate from investment qualification.

entries.title: Price / volume research
entries.purpose: Inspect historical trend and momentum conditions.
entries.how: Read the entry trigger, risk-line arithmetic, observation dates and corporate-action warnings.
entries.note: No validated return claim; momentum is not intrinsic value.

entries.title: Backtest readiness
entries.purpose: Understand what is still needed before publishing performance.
entries.how: Review the point-in-time, adjusted-price and historical-security coverage gaps.
entries.note: Synthetic fixtures are tests, not investment performance.

entries.title: Live status and CSV / JSON downloads
entries.purpose: Inspect actual evidence in a portable file.
entries.how: Read current status, then download a fresh API response as CSV or JSON.
entries.note: Exports are copies; editing them does not change the engine.

entries.title: NPSE project folder
entries.purpose: Find the governed research and audit folders.
entries.how: Open with your Drive account, then enter Research Library or Audit Trail.
entries.note: Existing Drive permissions apply.

entries.title: Research Library
entries.purpose: Find the completed corpus without restarting the literature review.
entries.how: Read the current READ FIRST document before using individual research files.
entries.note: Contains documents and registries, not a live quote feed.

entries.title: Research READ FIRST v1.1
entries.purpose: Identify the current corpus and its reading order.
entries.how: Use its stable references; preserve superseded documents as history.
entries.note: A navigation/authority document.

entries.title: Source Manifest v1.1
entries.purpose: Map all 37 source IDs to citations, URLs and archive states.
entries.how: Look up the source ID shown on a company page.
entries.note: A canonical URL is not proof of a mirrored Drive file.

entries.title: Original Source Register
entries.purpose: Read evidence scope, extracted use and freshness rules.
entries.how: Use alongside the formal manifest, not as an automatic data import.
entries.note: Registered methodology and evidence scope.

entries.title: Parsed Knowledge
entries.purpose: Inspect machine-readable financial implementation authority.
entries.how: Read SectorRules, InvestorPrinciples, FormulaRegistry, AuthorityMap, ImplementationMapping and EvidenceGaps.
entries.note: Sheet edits do not automatically rewrite Python rules.

entries.title: Literature Review v1.1
entries.purpose: Understand the six models, investor principles and source hierarchy.
entries.how: Read the sector relevant to your company, then its implementation consequences.
entries.note: Completed research; avoid replaying the whole search.

entries.title: Methods and Formulas
entries.purpose: Understand definitions and financial calculations.
entries.how: Match formula IDs and input definitions to the implementation trace.
entries.note: An assumed valuation multiple remains an implementation choice.

entries.title: Formal Bibliography v1.1
entries.purpose: Find formal source references.
entries.how: Follow the canonical source address and check its authority.
entries.note: Citation layer, not a connected feed.

entries.title: BibTeX corpus v1.1
entries.purpose: Reuse citation keys for research and reproducibility.
entries.how: Match each citation key one-to-one with a source ID.
entries.note: Machine-readable citation text.

entries.title: Source archive and snapshots
entries.purpose: Find retained source evidence under the archive policy.
entries.how: Check the manifest for an actual Drive file ID before assuming a document was mirrored.
entries.note: Includes archive classes; not every cited article has a local copy.

entries.title: Implementation handoff v1.1
entries.purpose: Read the implementation priorities and unresolved evidence gaps.
entries.how: Start future engineering work from the live implementation and this brief.
entries.note: Official price, normalized filings and sector-specific evidence remain incomplete.

entries.title: GitHub repository
entries.purpose: Review or update the website, Python engine and versioned data definitions.
entries.how: Read the README; inspect changes on a branch before production promotion.
entries.note: Private repository; existing GitHub account permissions apply.

entries.title: Database schema / SQL blueprint
entries.purpose: See which tables and relationships the database uses.
entries.how: Read the schema; use read-only inspection queries in Neon rather than rerunning setup casually.
entries.note: SQL text defines tables; it is not the stored production rows.

entries.title: Versioned research corpus JSON
entries.purpose: Inspect the exact research registry used by the engine.
entries.how: Compare source IDs, formula IDs and sector rules with Drive authority.
entries.note: This is a versioned snapshot of the consumed research authority.

entries.title: Reviewed financial extraction JSON
entries.purpose: Inspect the reviewed source extraction and normalization notes.
entries.how: Preserve report hashes, reporting periods and original publication availability.
entries.note: July 2026 period; source freshness still matters.

entries.title: Implementation contract and debt
entries.purpose: Understand adapter behavior, formula traceability and rollback.
entries.how: Read this before modifying a provider, financial rule or database admission path.
entries.note: Explains functional limits; does not promise complete feeds.

entries.title: Workspace link catalogue
entries.purpose: Keep these links, descriptions and statuses easy to update.
entries.how: Edit this JSON in a reviewed code change; the site rebuilds the directory from it.
entries.note: One maintained catalogue; no duplicated manual website link list.

entries.title: Neon / PostgreSQL console
entries.purpose: Inspect the deployed historical database and saved runs.
entries.how: Sign in and choose the database linked to NPSE in Vercel; see How to use for read-only SQL.
entries.note: Database access verified in the NPSE API on 6 October 2026. The console itself requires your provider account.

entries.title: Vercel NPSE project
entries.purpose: Manage deployments, runtime logs, storage linkage and environment variables.
entries.how: Open the NPSE project with your authorized account; deploy code through GitHub.
entries.note: Public runtime works; connector project-management access previously returned 404.

entries.title: Build and test runs
entries.purpose: Read the checks for a published change.
entries.how: Open the workflow for the exact commit and check its conclusion.
entries.note: Prior engine boundary passed 47 tests, including disposable Postgres.

entries.title: Current research JSON API
entries.purpose: Read the machine response behind the board.
entries.how: Open for inspection or use the guide's download controls; check run and observation dates.
entries.note: Opening this URL does not perform an authenticated database write.

entries.title: Research rules JSON API
entries.purpose: Inspect source, formula and rule registries without loading the whole board.
entries.how: Look up a source/formula ID shown on the company page.
entries.note: Separate from financial observation freshness.

entries.title: Project Local Library
entries.purpose: Find current code, lane records, lineage and project sync state.
entries.how: Read ReadFirst, then LaneJournal_CHAT and SyncState; sequence numbers track governed changes.
entries.note: Governance tracking, not the investment database.

entries.title: Audit Trail and reproduction
entries.purpose: Find PRE/POST rollback evidence, QA receipts and checkpoints.
entries.how: Match the receipt to the code commit and production observation.
entries.note: Snapshots are historical records, not competing current releases.

entries.title: Daily Evidence and five sources
entries.purpose: Read dated company events and plan the next evidence update.
entries.how: Inspect the original source, publication date, confirmation status and outstanding questions.
entries.note: One reviewed news event; no automatic news job or Slack delivery.

entries.title: Append-only daily evidence history
entries.purpose: Preserve what was known at each update.
entries.how: Append new evidence or a linked correction; use the operating guide before publishing.
entries.note: Qualitative context is not a normalized financial observation.

entries.title: A8 command routing
entries.purpose: Read the active NPSE local execution and federation boundary.
entries.how: Use the live A8 route before governance changes.
entries.note: External Fabin Main sync is separately requested.

entries.title: A8 Control Tower READ FIRST
entries.purpose: Find adopted local controls and their source mappings.
entries.how: Read this before following an older A9 alias.
entries.note: Historical A9 names do not authorize external Main writes.

entries.title: A8 adopted library/storage control
entries.purpose: Read evidence, structured-data ownership and closeout rules.
entries.how: Use with A8 routing and the NPSE implementation contract.
entries.note: Neon/GitHub/Sheets automatic reconciliation is not implemented.
